# Tests that fail on the upstream commit in `upstream-base` on a GitHub-hosted
# Linux runner, and still fail on the fork. The fork's CI leaves them out,
# because their failure is not the fork's to fix.
#
# Regenerate after every update from upstream: push the new upstream commit
# plus `.github/` to a `ci-baseline/` branch, take the failed-test list from
# the summary of its full-suite job, and keep the entries that also fail on
# the fork. One test per line: nextest binary id, a space, the test name.
#
# Source: upstream 9ba8eede54a42f9adc1f34603f40244d09781fed, run
# https://github.com/silvarbor/mcp_agent_mail_rust/actions/runs/43614866583,
# compared with the fork at 2063d047, run
# https://github.com/silvarbor/mcp_agent_mail_rust/actions/runs/43615481013.
